resources.string: Shows the weather and the time for a few seconds when you press a remote button while watching. It sees key presses but never blocks them, and reads only which app is in front, never what is on screen.
The weather (top left) and the time (top right) for 4 seconds, on the first button press after a quiet spell, over whatever you watch. Not over Home.
OK switches it off: the remote then works as if Glance were not installed.
Its service was switched off (a force-stop does this). OK switches it back on.
Glance may not switch its service back on. From a computer: adb shell pm grant %1$s android.permission.WRITE_SECURE_SETTINGS
If holding Volume Up only moves one step with Glance on, switch it off here: some TVs lose the volume ramp while a key service runs.
